findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. This condition skips the Claude SDK whenever `workers = "codex"`. But `forge close --choice switch` can set an item's `state["tool"]` to Claude (close.py:113-114), and `forge work` then requires the SDK. In a Codex-coordinated repo with `tools = "both"`, work refuses with `forge doctor --fix` as its next action, while that command neither reports nor installs the missing SDK.
findings.title: Doctor cannot install the SDK after an item switches to Claude

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Test. This replacement is a no-op: the new SDK stub has no `    if not int(os.environ.get(` line (tests/stubs/claude_agent_sdk.py:100-109). The land-build and land-fix cases therefore never make the worker merge the upgraded pin. Their expected pin-handoff notice cannot be produced, so the named command-level proof is broken.
findings.title: Not done: running commands follow changed Forge pin

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. This new SDK result check sends an empty answer to the `no_turn` refusal. Its next action at worker.py:58-60 still says to run `claude` once to answer the prompt. An SDK-only client, which this branch now supports, has no `claude` command on PATH and cannot follow that recovery step when a hooks prompt stops the turn.
